applicableAreas: Site plan sheets (retaining walls not assessed relative to transformer pads)
findings.comment: Retaining walls are present on the site (grading plan Sheet 11), but transformer pad locations are not integrated into the grading plan. Minimum 5-foot clearance from retaining walls cannot be verified from available plan coordination.

applicableAreas: Site plan perimeter (potential fence locations near transformer pads)
findings.comment: Site plan and landscape plan do not clearly show or dimensionally relate fence locations (including identifying which sides have operators/controls) to specific transformer pad locations. Clearances of 5 feet (for operator sides) or 3 feet (for non-operator sides) cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations shown on electrical plan
findings.comment: No transformer pad clearances are dimensioned on any plan, and architectural specifications confirming 3-hour fire rating are not provided in plan notes. If any clearances less than 5 feet to buildings are proposed, Austin Energy Design written approval and fire rating documentation are absent from the submission.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (building overhangs and balconies not coordinated)
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets or cross-section drawings are provided that would show overhangs, balconies, or any structures above transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot lateral clearance or overhead structure prohibition cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to building fenestration
findings.comment: Building elevation sheets showing windows, doors, and ventilating ducts with grade elevations are not provided. For oil-filled transformer equipment, the 12-foot horizontal clearance requirement when windows/doors/ducts are within 12 feet of grade or have less than 5 feet lateral separation cannot be verified. Additionally, equipment type (oil-filled vs. dry-type) is not identified.

applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 1 area (northwest near entrance driveway)
findings.comment: Site plan shows one transformer pad adjacent to a 5-foot concrete sidewalk, but the distance from the back of the sidewalk to the pad is not dimensioned. The required 2-foot minimum clearance from back of sidewalk per UCM § 1.10.4 cannot be confirmed.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Fire protection plan does not show transformer pad locations. Stairwell locations relative to transformer pads cannot be determined. Minimum clearance from stairwells serving as fire exits cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to fire escape structures
findings.comment: Fire protection plan does not identify any fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes on the building elevations, and transformer pad locations are not shown on the fire plan. For oil-filled transformer equipment, the required 20-foot horizontal/radial clearance from fire escapes cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All 5 transformer pad locations on electrical plan
findings.comment: Transformer pad access door orientation is not shown on any plan sheet. Without identifying which side is the access door, the 10-foot hot-stick use area clearance requirement to open area or adjacent building/structure cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations, particularly Pads 2 and 5 (located in tight courtyard areas)
findings.comment: Site plan configuration and building floor plans do not clearly indicate whether any transformer pads face confined spaces (niches, vaults, or areas enclosed on 3+ sides). Cross-section drawings demonstrating vertical clearance within confined spaces are absent. The 15-foot clearance requirement for confined spaces cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to fire hydrants
findings.comment: Fire protection plan shows fire hydrants but does not show transformer pad locations. Distance between the two private fire hydrants and the five transformer pads cannot be determined. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Site landscaping areas where trees are proposed within 10 lateral feet of transformer pads
findings.comment: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations. Therefore, trees within 10 lateral feet of pad-mounted equipment cannot be identified, and their species cannot be cross-referenced against ECM Appendix F for utility-compatible designation. Utility compatibility for trees within 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution conductors also cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Site landscaping areas adjacent to transformer pads
findings.comment: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations or identify their access door orientation relative to proposed shrubs and vegetation. Clearances of 10 lateral feet from access door side and 5 lateral feet from other sides cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: Site landscaping areas where trees are proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: Landscape plan does not show transformer pad locations. Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric infrastructure cannot be identified, and root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, installed 5 feet from equipment) cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to dumpsters/trash facilities
findings.comment: Dumpster locations are not shown on site plan or electrical plan in direct spatial relationship to transformer pad locations. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to bike racks
findings.comment: Bike rack locations are not dimensionally referenced to transformer pad locations on any site plan sheet. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to light poles
findings.comment: Light pole locations relative to transformer pads are not dimensionally shown on site plan or electrical plan. Minimum 5-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to fire lanes
findings.comment: Fire protection plan shows fire lanes but does not show transformer pad locations. Distance from transformer pads to fire lane boundaries cannot be determined. Minimum 15-foot clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (5 pads shown on electrical plan)
findings.comment: Five transformer pads are shown on the electrical plan, but distances between individual pads are not dimensioned. Minimum 5-foot clearance between transformer pads cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to underground utilities
findings.comment: While utility tap plan (Sheet 19) shows underground utility lines, transformer pad locations from electrical plan (Sheet 21) are not integrated or dimensionally correlated on the same sheet. Minimum 12-inch horizontal and vertical clearance from other underground utilities cannot be verified from available cross-referenced plans.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to overhead and underground utility infrastructure
findings.comment: Utility plans do not clearly show whether transformer pads are positioned under or over any underground utility lines. Overhead electric lines are shown on landscape and electrical plans, but dimensional separation is not verified. Compliance with prohibition against structures installed over Austin Energy underground facilities cannot be confirmed.

applicableAreas: Transformer Pads 1, 2, 3 (located near existing overhead electric line on western property boundary)
findings.comment: Overhead electric line (OHE) is identified on electrical and landscape plans running along the western property line near Pads 1, 2, and 3, but the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from distribution conductors is not dimensioned or verified on any plan.

applicableAreas: Transformer Pads 1, 2, 3 (near overhead electric line on western property boundary)
findings.comment: Overhead electric (OHE) line is shown on electrical plan running near the western property boundary where Pads 1, 2, and 3 are located. The 15-foot radius clearance from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors (measured from conductors, not pole centerline) is not dimensioned or verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (if any are in niche, enclosed, or notched-out areas)
findings.comment: Site plan and electrical plan do not provide building cross-section drawings or explicit identification of whether any transformer pads are located in niches, enclosed areas, or notched-out configurations. The 35-foot vertical clearance requirement inside niche and entrance cannot be verified through available documentation.

applicableAreas: All transformer locations (if any niche service is proposed)
findings.comment: No architectural specifications or electrical plan notes document fire wall ratings (3-hour requirement) for any niche service installations. No evidence of consultation with Austin Energy Design business unit regarding niche-specific requirements is provided in the application.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations where access paths include overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings are provided showing vertical clearances in access paths to transformer pads where overhead structures, building eaves, or parking structures may exist. Vertical clearance compliance in access areas cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations (if oil-filled equipment is proposed)
findings.comment: Electrical specifications do not identify whether transformer equipment is oil-filled or dry-type. Grading plan does not show transformer pad locations or surface drainage direction around pads. For oil-filled equipment, the requirement that liquid flow be directed away from buildings cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All 5 transformer pad locations shown on electrical plan
findings.comment: While transformer pads appear to be located on private property based on spatial relationship to property lines shown on site and electrical plans, explicit confirmation that transformer locations are 100% on private property (not straddling property lines or in public right-of-way) is not provided in plan notes or calculations.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to drainage, water, sewer, and electrical easements shown on site plan
findings.comment: Multiple easements are identified on the grading and site plans (drainage easements, wastewater easement, electrical easements). However, transformer pad locations from the electrical plan are not dimensionally correlated to these easements. Confirmation that pads are not located in prohibited easements (drainage, water, sewer, or under overhead electrical lines) without Austin Energy Design written approval cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All 5 transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No transformer easements are shown around the five transformer pads on any plan sheet. Easement widths required for Austin Energy accessibility and equipment replacement cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations and electrical routing from transformer to meter
findings.comment: Electrical routing from transformer pads to meter locations is shown on the electrical plan, but explicit confirmation that 100% of the routing is on private property (not crossing public right-of-way or easements) is not provided in plan notes.

applicableAreas: All 5 transformer pad locations on electrical plan
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions do not match or reference Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets. Electrical plan shows transformer symbols but no pad dimensions (length/width/height), and no callout to AE Design details. Site plan contains only a note stating 'need to look up approx. detail.' Applicant must obtain and reference AE Design-approved transformer pad specifications for the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase).

applicableAreas: Transformer Pad 1 (immediately adjacent to main entrance driveway curb); other pads require confirmation of parking/vehicle route proximity
findings.comment: No bollards are shown or dimensioned on any plan. Transformer Pad 1 is drawn immediately adjacent to the main driveway curb (appears to be within 4 feet of vehicle circulation). Plan does not reference AE Design equipment pad detail sheets that would specify bollard requirements (4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts) and spacing to allow equipment door opening.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations and proposed site structures relative to overhead distribution facilities shown on western property line
findings.comment: Overhead electric (OHE) line is shown on plans running along the western boundary near transformer Pads 1, 2, and 3. Confirmation that customer facilities (buildings, parking structures, light poles, signs, antennas, tanks) are not installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities is not explicitly provided in plan notes.
